subject: Hex OS FAQ: document that ids are case-insensitive and that Tab completes
description:
The FAQ (_app/hex/faq.html) exists to preempt 'what is Hex OS and how do I use it', and says nothing about either. Eight case-sensitivity defects were fixed because students reasonably type capitals; the shell now accepts them everywhere, and Tab completes commands, app ids, places and manual pages including after a capitalised verb. Neither fact is documented anywhere a student reads. Add to the 'How do I find the thing I actually want?' section: capitals are fine, and Tab completes. Small, but it converts a fix nobody can see into something a student can use. NOT done during the Chris gate on the same tree; queued deliberately. Related: the same FAQ's existing warn box about run <group> is the model to follow.
[2026-09-02 18:32] Shipped 2026-09-02 in the 7.2.0 HARDLINE release. The FAQ now has a 'Do I have to type it exactly?' section covering case-insensitivity, Tab completion, second-Tab cycling, and the deliberate session-id exception. Every example in it is executed by _tools/hexos/doc-examples.test.js, wired into post-verify, because the first draft contained examples I had never typed and two of three were broken.
